$comment: Atlas governance policy — ADMIN-OWNED BY INTENT, versioned. WARNING, read this before trusting the file: the CODEOWNERS + branch-protection lock described in docs/governance/policy-lock.md is NOT IN FORCE. The previous wording said it COULD NOT be turned on (a 403 under the old private plan); that became false when the repo went public on 2026-08-01, and this comment was stale until 2026-08-02. Measured 2026-08-02: master IS protected (required check 'gate', enforce_admins on, no force-push, no deletion), but the leg that would gate THIS file is off — require_code_owner_reviews is false, required_approving_review_count is 0, and a CODEOWNERS is only now being added. So the lock is ACHIEVABLE and NOT YET CONFIGURED, which is a different claim from the one this comment used to make. Two further preconditions, neither met at the time of writing: the atlas-admins team holds no grant on this repository, and automation currently pushes under the owner's own GitHub identity — a review requirement cannot distinguish two actors sharing one identity. Anyone with write access can therefore still edit this file directly. The ONE control that IS live is the loader's fail-closed default: absent/malformed => empty scopes => NO write is authorized.

nearDup.$comment: Near-duplicate matcher threshold (feeds @atlas/knowledge NearDupConfig.claimNormThreshold). 1 = exact-match only (conservative). Lower toward ~0.85 to merge near-synonym claims once the synonym-tau is trusted.

t0Heuristic.$comment: Keywords that flag a fact as a T0 (human-ratification) candidate.

authz.$comment: Owner-scoped write (KNOW-11): scope => actor ids authorized to write it. Reads are universal regardless. An unlisted scope or actor is fail-closed (no write). Replace the placeholder seat with real actor ids.
